what: Published values of Grossman & Boudaoud (2026) used as references. There is no reference code: the authors' simulation and computation code is 'available at request' (Data Availability, p. 10).

paper.license: CC BY 4.0 (Crossref license record; stated on p. 1)

files.paper_values.json: transcribed by hand from the text and the Supplemental Material, with page and equation numbers
files.paper_figures_vector.json: Figs. 7, 8 and 9 are vector graphics in the PDF; their marks and lines were read from the PDF drawing commands by reference/extract_vector_figures.py (PyMuPDF 2.0, Python 3.14), with the axes calibrated on the drawn major tick marks. Precision about 1e-3 of the axis range
